newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet prices fall, cargo premiums pressured.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet prices fall, cargo premiums pressured.

text.p: Jet fuel prices fell with IPE futures on Thursday, with barge premiums steady and those for cargoes slightly easier, traders said.
Nov IPE futures was trading $2.25 down at $223.75 on profit-taking and mild weather across Europe.
Barges was talked at Nov IPE +$33 fob NWE, unchanged, in desultory business.
Cargoes were discussed at Nov IPE +$29/30 cif NWE and +$24 fob, slightly easier. In the Med, European Union-qualified material was fob Med high +$6. Non EU-qualified was $1 cheaper, also unchanged.
